lines.intro: This is the Experiments tab of your forge. Four steps: a baseline, one change, the same questions again, then before and after.
lines.baseline: Run 1 is the shipped toolbox: our baseline. Six of six right.
lines.pick: Pick: too little in every result. Check stock now returns only the total, with no warehouses.
lines.settings: Six tools now return the fewest fields. Nothing else is different.
lines.run: Run the six questions again. It takes about a minute. Here it is sped up.
lines.result: Before and after. Two questions went from right to wrong: question 1 and question 3.
lines.tiles: Four of six right. Five more tool calls, and about eight thousand more tokens: the model keeps calling, looking for what is missing.
lines.table: Question 1 asks about Manchester. The result had only the total, so the answer could not say five thousand four hundred. On question 3 the model called check budget three times, looking for a figure that was no longer there.
lines.next: Next: try another change, or set one by hand on the Anvil. After two or three knobs, go on to the Shield.
